denominators.anyps5_main: matched definitions / indexed library+NID records, not functionality
denominators.library_320: registered 3.20 forwarder bindings observed in source, not 13.60 exports
denominators.pr_scan: current open PR heads successfully scanned / all currently open PRs
denominators.verified_name_rate: strictly rehashed named / all indexed library+NID records

limitations: If open-PR scanning was skipped, its per-library counts are null (unknown), not zero.
An absent PR match is unknown while PR scanning is incomplete.
The 3.20-only source is not evidence of a firmware 13.60 export.
Source definitions are not proof of registration, ABI, build or runtime verification.
Live implementation correctness is not measured; null means unknown.
Priority score indicates triage value, not safe stub-generation eligibility.

recent_changes.note: These are source-level identity or status changes only; function bodies, runtime behaviour and ABI correctness are not compared.
